Alabama.concealed_carry: Permitless (constitutional) carry since Jan 1, 2023 for 19+ (18+ military); shall-issue permit system kept for reciprocity
Alabama.open_carry: Generally allowed (handgun must be in a holster; 18+)
Alabama.reciprocity: Recognizes valid concealed carry permits from all other states

Alaska.concealed_carry: Permitless carry for 21+; shall-issue permit available for reciprocity purposes
Alaska.reciprocity: Recognizes valid concealed carry permits from all other states

Arizona.concealed_carry: Permitless carry for 21+ since 2010; shall-issue permit still available
Arizona.reciprocity: Recognizes all valid out-of-state permits (holder must be 21+)

Arkansas.concealed_carry: Permitless carry (clarified by 2023 Act 777); shall-issue permit available, 21+ (18 military)
Arkansas.reciprocity: Honors carry licenses from every other state

California.concealed_carry: Permit required; shall-issue since Bruen/SB 2 (no more 'good cause'); 21+
California.private_sale_bg_check: Universal background checks required (all transfers through a licensed dealer)
California.reciprocity: Does not recognize any out-of-state permits

Colorado.concealed_carry: Permit required; shall-issue through county sheriff; 21+
Colorado.open_carry: Generally allowed (some cities, e.g. Denver, ban it)
Colorado.private_sale_bg_check: Universal background checks required (through a licensed dealer, via CBI)
Colorado.reciprocity: Recognizes out-of-state permits if holder is a resident of the issuing state and 21+

Connecticut.open_carry: Prohibited since Oct 1, 2023, with limited exceptions
Connecticut.private_sale_bg_check: Universal background checks required (via DESPP authorization number)
Connecticut.waiting_period: 10 days (transfer no earlier than the 11th day after authorization)

Delaware.concealed_carry: Permit required; may-issue (Superior Court, 'good moral character' standard); 18+
Delaware.private_sale_bg_check: Background check required through a licensed dealer (limited exceptions)
Delaware.reciprocity: Recognizes permits from a limited list of states, published annually by the AG

Florida.concealed_carry: Permitless carry for 21+ (18+ military) since July 1, 2023; license still available
Florida.open_carry: Generally allowed (open carry ban struck down as unconstitutional Sept 2025)
Florida.waiting_period: 3 days (excluding weekends/holidays; waived for license holders)

Georgia.concealed_carry: Permitless carry since April 12, 2022 (SB 319); shall-issue Weapons Carry License available, 21+ (18 military)
Georgia.reciprocity: Recognizes licenses from all other states

Hawaii.concealed_carry: Permit required; shall-issue (since 2023 Act 52), 21+, residents only
Hawaii.open_carry: Prohibited (separate license requiring demonstrated need, rarely granted)
Hawaii.private_sale_bg_check: Required (universal; purchase permit with background check required for all transfers)
Hawaii.reciprocity: None; does not recognize any out-of-state permits

Idaho.reciprocity: Honors permits from all other states; 18+ may carry permitless

Illinois.concealed_carry: Permit required (Concealed Carry License), shall-issue, 21+ (FOID also required)
Illinois.private_sale_bg_check: Required (universal; FOID verification and state police approval)
Illinois.reciprocity: None; does not recognize any out-of-state permits

Indiana.concealed_carry: Permitless carry (since July 1, 2022), 18+; optional shall-issue license
Indiana.reciprocity: Honors permits from all other states
Indiana.red_flag_law: yes (Jake Laird Law; law-enforcement seizure with hearing within 14 days)

Iowa.reciprocity: Honors permits from all other states (permit holder must be 21)

Kansas.concealed_carry: Permitless carry (since 2015), 21+; optional shall-issue license (provisional for 18-20)
Kansas.reciprocity: Honors permits from all other states

Kentucky.concealed_carry: Permitless carry (since 2019), 21+; optional shall-issue CCDW license
Kentucky.reciprocity: Honors permits from all other states

Louisiana.concealed_carry: Permitless carry (since July 4, 2024), 18+; optional shall-issue permit
Louisiana.reciprocity: Honors permits only from states that recognize Louisiana permits (~36 states)

Maine.concealed_carry: Permitless carry (since 2015), 21+ (18-20 with optional permit or military service)
Maine.private_sale_bg_check: Required only for advertised or gun-show private sales (must go through dealer)
Maine.reciprocity: Recognizes resident permits from states that recognize Maine's resident permits (mutual reciprocity)
Maine.red_flag_law: yes (Question 2 approved by voters Nov 2025; ERPO law alongside existing yellow flag law)
Maine.waiting_period: 72 hours (enjoined by court order in 2025; litigation pending)

Maryland.concealed_carry: Permit required (Wear and Carry Permit), shall-issue post-Bruen, 21+
Maryland.private_sale_bg_check: Required (universal; all transfers through licensed dealer)
Maryland.reciprocity: None; does not recognize any out-of-state permits

Massachusetts.concealed_carry: Permit required (License to Carry); may-issue with suitability discretion, age 21
Massachusetts.open_carry: Generally allowed with a License to Carry
Massachusetts.private_sale_bg_check: Required for all private transfers (purchaser's license verified via state Gun Transaction Portal)
Massachusetts.reciprocity: No reciprocity; does not recognize any out-of-state permits.

Michigan.concealed_carry: Permit required (Concealed Pistol License); shall-issue, age 21
Michigan.open_carry: Generally allowed without a permit (18+; heavily restricted in vehicles without a CPL)
Michigan.private_sale_bg_check: Universal background checks required (all firearms, since Feb 2024)
Michigan.reciprocity: Recognizes all valid out-of-state resident permits.

Minnesota.concealed_carry: Permit required (Permit to Carry); shall-issue, age 18 (court ruling 2023)
Minnesota.open_carry: Allowed with a Permit to Carry (permit covers both open and concealed)
Minnesota.private_sale_bg_check: Required for handguns and semi-automatic military-style assault weapons; not required for ordinary long guns
Minnesota.reciprocity: Recognizes permits from states with 'substantially similar' laws (about 35 states).

Mississippi.concealed_carry: Permitless carry (no permit required since 2016); optional shall-issue license available for reciprocity

Missouri.concealed_carry: Permitless carry (no permit required since 2017, age 19; 18 for military); optional shall-issue permit for reciprocity
Missouri.open_carry: Generally allowed without a permit (localities may restrict open carry by those without a permit)

Montana.concealed_carry: Permitless carry (no permit required since 2021); optional shall-issue permit available for reciprocity
Montana.reciprocity: Recognizes permits from states that recognize Montana permits.

Nebraska.concealed_carry: Permitless carry (no permit required since Sept 2023, age 21); optional shall-issue permit available
Nebraska.private_sale_bg_check: Required for handguns (buyer must have a Firearm Purchase Permit or Concealed Handgun Permit); not required for long guns
Nebraska.reciprocity: Recognizes permits from states that recognize Nebraska permits.

Nevada.concealed_carry: Permit required (Concealed Firearm Permit); shall-issue, age 21 (18 for military)
Nevada.private_sale_bg_check: Universal background checks required (through a licensed dealer since 2020)
Nevada.reciprocity: Recognizes permits from a specific list of states (about 30); does not honor all states.

New Hampshire.concealed_carry: Permitless carry (no permit required since Feb 2017); optional shall-issue license for reciprocity
New Hampshire.reciprocity: Honors many states' resident permits (not non-resident permits); permitless carry covers everyone who may lawfully possess.

New Jersey.concealed_carry: Permit required; shall-issue since Bruen (2022), age 21
New Jersey.private_sale_bg_check: Universal background checks required (all transfers through a licensed dealer, with narrow exceptions)
New Jersey.reciprocity: No reciprocity; does not recognize any out-of-state permits.
New Jersey.waiting_period: 7 days (minimum between permit application and handgun delivery)

New Mexico.private_sale_bg_check: Universal background checks required (through a licensed dealer; family exemption)
New Mexico.reciprocity: Recognizes concealed carry permits from about two dozen states with comparable licensing standards.
New Mexico.waiting_period: 7 days (struck down by 10th Circuit in 2025; enforcement disputed)

New York.concealed_carry: Permit required; shall-issue since Bruen (2022); minimum age 21
New York.open_carry: Handguns prohibited; long guns generally allowed
New York.private_sale_bg_check: Universal background checks required (through a licensed dealer; immediate-family exemption)
New York.reciprocity: Does not honor any out-of-state concealed carry permits.

North Carolina.private_sale_bg_check: Not required (pistol purchase permit repealed in 2023)
North Carolina.reciprocity: Honors all valid out-of-state concealed carry permits.

North Dakota.concealed_carry: Permitless (constitutional) carry for 18+ with valid ID; shall-issue licenses still offered
North Dakota.open_carry: Allowed with restrictions (requires a permit North Dakota issues or honors)
North Dakota.reciprocity: Honors permits from states that have reciprocity with North Dakota (permit must be from holder's home state).

Ohio.concealed_carry: Permitless carry for qualifying adults 21+; shall-issue licenses still offered
Ohio.reciprocity: Honors all valid out-of-state concealed carry permits.

Oklahoma.concealed_carry: Permitless carry for 21+ (18+ for military); shall-issue licenses still offered
Oklahoma.reciprocity: Recognizes any valid out-of-state concealed or unconcealed carry permit by statute.
Oklahoma.red_flag_law: no (state has an anti-red flag law)

Oregon.open_carry: Allowed with restrictions (cities/counties may ban loaded firearms in public)
Oregon.private_sale_bg_check: Universal background checks required (through a licensed dealer; statutory exemptions)
Oregon.reciprocity: Does not honor any out-of-state concealed carry permits.

Pennsylvania.concealed_carry: License to Carry Firearms required; shall-issue; minimum age 21
Pennsylvania.open_carry: Generally allowed; restricted in Philadelphia (license required there)
Pennsylvania.private_sale_bg_check: Required for handguns only (long guns not required)
Pennsylvania.reciprocity: Recognizes resident permits from about 30 states under AG reciprocity agreements.

Rhode Island.concealed_carry: Permit required; hybrid shall-issue (towns) / may-issue (Attorney General); minimum age 21
Rhode Island.reciprocity: Does not honor any out-of-state concealed carry permits.

South Carolina.concealed_carry: Permitless carry for 18+ (since March 2024); shall-issue permits still offered
South Carolina.reciprocity: Recognizes resident permits from listed reciprocal states; not universal.

South Dakota.concealed_carry: Permitless carry — no permit required for residents or non-residents 18+; permits still issued for reciprocity travel
South Dakota.reciprocity: No permit is needed to carry in South Dakota, so out-of-state permit holders are covered without one (state repealed its reciprocity statute)

Tennessee.concealed_carry: Permitless carry at 21+ (18–20 only with qualifying military service); shall-issue permits also available
Tennessee.reciprocity: Recognizes concealed carry permits from all other states

Texas.concealed_carry: Permitless carry at 21+ (HB 1927, effective Sept 2021); shall-issue License to Carry still available
Texas.open_carry: Generally allowed — handguns must be carried in a holster
Texas.reciprocity: Honors out-of-state permits whose issuing requirements Texas deems substantially similar (most states)

Utah.concealed_carry: Permitless carry at 21+; 18–20 may carry with a provisional permit
Utah.open_carry: Generally allowed at 21+; 18–20 may open carry unloaded without a permit
Utah.reciprocity: Recognizes valid concealed carry permits from other states

Vermont.concealed_carry: Permitless carry — no permit required and Vermont has no permit system at all
Vermont.private_sale_bg_check: Universal background checks required, including on private transfers
Vermont.reciprocity: Vermont issues no permits; anyone who may lawfully possess a firearm may carry without one, so reciprocity is not a factor

Virginia.private_sale_bg_check: Universal background checks required (restored by 2026 law after a 2025 court ruling struck down the prior version)
Virginia.reciprocity: Recognizes out-of-state permits, but only for holders age 21 and older

Washington.open_carry: Generally allowed, with some sensitive places restricted
Washington.private_sale_bg_check: Universal background checks required — private transfers must go through a licensed dealer
Washington.reciprocity: Recognizes out-of-state permits only from a short list of states meeting Washington's standards

West Virginia.concealed_carry: Permitless carry at 21+ (provisional permit available at 18); shall-issue permits still offered
West Virginia.reciprocity: No permit needed to carry in West Virginia; WV-issued permits are recognized by many other states

Wisconsin.reciprocity: Recognizes permits from many other states, subject to the state's official recognized-state list
Wisconsin.waiting_period: none (the old 48-hour handgun wait was repealed in 2015)

Wyoming.concealed_carry: Permitless carry at 21+ for any U.S. resident who may lawfully possess a firearm; permits still available
Wyoming.reciprocity: Recognizes out-of-state permits; no permit needed to carry in Wyoming
